presets.headline: Lend USDC only. No directional exposure, a quarter of the book always in cash.
presets.tradeoff: Gives up every source of return except lending, so it cannot earn maker fees or benefit from a move in ETH. A tight 10 bps slippage ceiling also means it will decline trades a looser mandate would take.

presets.headline: Half USDC, half WETH, rebalanced on drift — and the idle half put to work.
presets.tradeoff: Holding WETH means the vault's value moves with ETH, so a depositor can be down in USDC terms through no fault of the strategy. Rebalancing also costs slippage each time drift is corrected.

presets.headline: Chase the best risk-adjusted return across lending and Aqua market-making. Concentrates.
presets.tradeoff: A 5% cash floor and an 80% position cap mean a bad entry is felt in full, and a 15-minute cooldown lets it act on noise. Expect a visibly bumpier share price than the other two.
